title: Szoboszlai's Masterclass Seals Liverpool's Victory Over Tottenham
seoTitle: Szoboszlai's Masterclass Seals Liverpool Win Over.
subtitle: A 25-meter stoppage-time strike secured the Reds' victory at Anfield
excerpt: Dominik Szoboszlai scored a stunning stoppage-time goal, sealing Liverpool's 3-1 Carabao Cup victory over Tottenham, while De Zerbi laments the lack of.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Liverpool advanced to the fourth round of the Carabao Cup by defeating Tottenham 3-1 at Anfield, thanks to a 25-meter strike from Dominik Szoboszlai in stoppage time. The goal sealed the Spurs' defeat, as they had yet to score against a Premier League side.

How Szoboszlai's Goal Changed the Scoreline

Alexis Mac Allister opened the scoring for Liverpool, followed by Cody Gakpo who extended the lead before halftime. Conor Gallagher pulled one back for Tottenham, but the advantage was restored when Szoboszlai, receiving a touch from Gakpo, unleashed a powerful shot that found the back of the net, described as a "worldie" by coach Andoni Iraola.

How Liverpool Stood Out in the Clash

Besides the decisive goal, Liverpool benefited from contributions by Lewis Koumas, James McConnell, Trey Nyoni, and Rio Ngumoha, who displayed energy and aggression. Goalkeeper Giorgi Mamardashvili made important saves, including one that prevented Omar Marmoush from equalizing.

What De Zerbi Highlighted After the Defeat

Roberto De Zerbi acknowledged that his team created opportunities but lamented the lack of finishing and the frustration with the result. He stated that the players need to "click" and that, despite the difficulties, he believes in the squad's qualities.

Andoni Iraola's Reaction to Szoboszlai's Performance

Andoni Iraola praised Szoboszlai's confidence, saying that "you trust he's going to score even before he shoots." The coach emphasized that the third goal was a "worldie" and highlighted Lewis Koumas's infectious energy.

Key Moments of the Match

  • 21' – Mac Allister opens the scoring with a high shot.
  • 54' – Gakpo extends the lead to 2-0.
  • 69' – Gallagher scores the Spurs' only goal.
  • 86' – Mamardashvili makes a crucial save against Marmoush.
  • 90+1' – Szoboszlai seals the score with a long-range strike.

With information from The Guardian, Sky Sports.
